enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes regularly. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Remains asleep. Stretches legs. Curls up. Remains asleep. Snores.

Wakes up. Sits up. Stands. Walks to bathroom. Opens door. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on tap. Washes hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk, eggs, butter. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out frying pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Flips eggs. Turns off stove. Slides eggs onto plate. Toasts bread. Spreads butter. Pours milk. Sits at table and eats.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for work, reviewing tasks and setting up computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on light. Opens closet. Takes out clothes. Changes clothes. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Logs in. Opens email. Reviews schedule. Opens task list. Makes notes. Adjusts chair. Tests microphone. Tests webcam. Reviews patient files.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: telehealth consultations and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Puts on headset. Opens video conferencing software. Joins meeting. Greets patient. Asks questions. Listens. Takes notes. Types. Ends call. Writes documentation. Saves file. Opens next patient file. Dials patient. Conducts consultation. Asks follow-up questions. Types notes. Ends call. Updates records. Schedules follow-up.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out salad, dressing. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out plate. Places salad on plate. Pours dressing. Takes out fork. Carries plate to table. Sits down. Eats salad. Drinks water. Finishes meal. Picks up plate. Carries to sink. Rinses plate. Places in dishwasher. Wipes table.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: patient follow-ups and administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens patient database. Reviews records. Makes phone calls. Says: 'Hello, this is Member 1 from the clinic.' Discusses test results. Takes notes. Types summary. Sends emails. Fills out forms. Updates billing. Scans documents. Files paperwork. Opens calendar. Schedules appointments. Checks inventory. Orders supplies. Organizes desk. Shreds old documents. Closes computer.

Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Settles on news. Watches TV. Puts feet on coffee table. Adjusts pillow. Watches. Changes channel. Watches. Turns off TV.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables, chicken. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out cutting board and knife. Chops vegetables. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Cooks. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Turns off stove. Slides food onto plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Cleans up.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time: watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on couch. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Opens laptop. Logs in. Opens web browser. Checks social media. Watches videos. Types comments. Switches to TV. Watches show. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens game. Plays game. Pauses game. Watches TV. Closes laptop. Turns off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed: showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Undresses. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Grabs towel. Dries body. Wraps towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light and exits.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns again. Moves arm. Remains asleep. Snores.
